title: Inhibikase Therapeutics Announces FDA Orphan Drug Designation Granted to IKT-001 for the Treatment of PAH
summary: WILMINGTON, Del., July 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Inhibikase Therapeutics, Inc.
